description: This file defines an enumeration 'CategorySortingMethod' for different sorting methods used in the application, including their IDs and SQL order strings, along with methods to retrieve and find enum instances by ID.

classes.name: CategorySortingMethod
classes.description: An enum representing different category sorting methods with associated IDs and SQL order strings, along with utility methods for retrieval.

methods.name: CategorySortingMethod(int id, String title)
methods.description: Constructor initializing enum instances with an ID and title.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID associated with the sorting method.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the SQL order string for the sorting method.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a CategorySortingMethod instance based on a given ID, modulo the number of enum values.
